title.es: Manejo respetuoso de perros y gatos
title.en: Respectful care for dogs and cats

text.en: Owners highlight the groomer's genuine love for animals and her gentle handling of both young kittens and elderly dogs. Reviews emphasize the low-stress cat grooming approach, where feline guests receive patient, unhurried care designed to minimize distress.
